name: Tax and bookkeeping practice
summary: A practice desk with two flows: winning a mandate through an identification step and engagement letter, and doing the recurring work per client, with a deadline register that a second person verifies.
description: Run a tax or bookkeeping practice from one place: mandates from inquiry to an active engagement with a money-laundering identification step in between, recurring jobs per client and period with a waiting-for-documents status, and a register of deadlines with a pre-deadline and the person who verified each date. It is the relationship, deadline-evidence and follow-up layer next to your practice software. It does not compute legal dates, file returns, keep ledgers, run payroll or bill time, and it holds no tax IDs or ID copies.

prompt.intro: Set up a tax and bookkeeping practice in my Customermates workspace: mandates from inquiry to active with an identification step, recurring jobs per client and period, a deadline register with a pre-deadline and a verifier, and dated follow-ups. Never compute legal dates and never store ID copies.
questions: Which services do you offer, and which recurring jobs do you run per client?
In which country do you practise, and which deadlines do you track?
Who prepares, who reviews, and who verifies a deadline?
How do you identify new clients, and how often do you review their risk rating?
